title: Logos 27 opening: only true God (Jn 17:3)
english: Twenty-seventh discourse. On “that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you sent.”
“Only true God” of the Father is not taken as denial of the Son’s natural deity.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
